MM2_IMPORT_DESCRIPTION: Extract stock assets to Files/common/MidtownMadness2. Completed files remain if the import fails or is cancelled; rerun to import the rest. This cannot be undone.
MM2_IMPORT_GAME_FOLDER_TOOLTIP: Select the installed game's folder containing MM2CORE.AR and MM2TEX.AR. Mods and loose files are ignored.
MM2_IMPORT_OVERWRITE_TOOLTIP: Replace matching assets with the stock versions. Otherwise existing files are skipped, including names with different capitalization. Other files are preserved.
MM2_IMPORT_FAILED: {error} Completed files remain. Rerun the import to finish; existing files are skipped unless overwrite is enabled.
MM2_IMPORT_FOLDER_REQUIRED: Select an MM2 game folder containing MM2CORE.AR and MM2TEX.AR.
MM2_IMPORT_FOLDER_MISSING: The MM2 game folder does not exist: {folder}
MM2_IMPORT_ARCHIVE_MISSING: {archive} was not found in {folder}. Select the game's installation folder containing both stock archives.
MM2_IMPORT_AMBIGUOUS: Several files or folders have the same name ignoring capitalization: {path}. Keep only one before importing.
MM2_IMPORT_SIGNATURE: {archive}: unsupported archive signature {signature}. Use the original MM2 DAVE archives, not ZIP mods or the Dave variant with compressed filenames.
MM2_IMPORT_INDEX: {archive}: invalid or truncated DAVE header, index or filename block.
MM2_IMPORT_NAME: {archive}: invalid or unterminated filename at index {index}.
MM2_IMPORT_DECOMPRESSION: {archive}: {entry}: corrupt compressed data or decompressed size mismatch.
MM2_IMPORT_NO_ASSETS: {archive}: no supported stock assets were found. Use the original MM2 archive.
MM2_IMPORT_DESTINATION: {archive}: {entry}: the destination is not a regular file or directory inside {destination}.
